source.note: 550 numbered base cards in two series; nine insert checklists, Press Proofs, and die-cut Power Alley. Promos excluded.

decisions.baseStructure: Series 1 #1-330 and Series 2 #331-550 combined into one 550-card base ProductSet, equal base probability.
decisions.canonicalPackFormat: VCS one standard four-card pack; 36 packs per box follows Series 1 hobby distribution. Series 2 boxes had 18 packs.
decisions.packChannelAbstraction: Original hobby/retail and two-series insert channels are represented in one VCS pack; historical single-channel odds are recorded where verifiable, mixed-series odds left null.
decisions.parallelStructure: 550 Press Proofs derived from Base; 10 Power Alley Die Cuts derived from the Power Alley insert.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: Only the 13 TCDB rookie-indexed base card numbers receive RC. Rated Rookie RR alone is not treated as a true RC.
decisions.checklistHandling: Seven numbered base checklists and Diamond Kings DK-31 use a clean Checklist subject, empty team, and featured subject in Variant where appropriate.
decisions.teamHandling: Team names checked against contemporary sets and manually resolved for trades and missing names. #399 Kevin Brown uses the 1996 Marlins club instead of an apparent Orioles reference error; images pending review.
decisions.excludedRelatedItems: Pre-release/promotional sets are omitted; pack-issued inserts and the two relevant parallels are included.
decisions.releaseSafety: Images and pricing remain pending; historical mixed-series odds require review before release.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Complete Series 1 #1-330 and Series 2 #331-550 combined equally in one base pool.

productSets.name: Press Proofs
productSets.notes: Full parallel, serial numbered /2000. Series 1 1:12 packs; Series 2 1:10; combined-pack odds require review.

productSets.name: Diamond Kings
productSets.notes: DK-1 to DK-31; numbered to 10,000. First 14 were Series 1, last 17 Series 2; published Series 2 odds conflict.

productSets.name: Elite Series
productSets.notes: #61-72; numbered to 10,000. Series 1 and 2 had different odds (1:75 and 1:40).

productSets.name: Hit List
productSets.notes: Series 1 #1-8 and Series 2 #9-16; numbered to 10,000; odds differ by series.

productSets.name: Power Alley
productSets.notes: Series 1 hobby exclusive, numbered to 5,000; historically 1:92 packs.

productSets.name: Power Alley Die Cuts
productSets.notes: Die-cut copies of the Power Alley checklist; first 500 of each player's 5,000 copies. Independent pack odds unverified.

productSets.name: Showdown
productSets.notes: Series 1; two players per card, historically 1:105 packs.
